verdict.rationale: Jeeves publishes an llms.txt at tryjeeves.com/llms.txt, which summarizes its products, including stablecoin payments, Jeeves Cash, expense management and the API Platform. However, the developer docs portal returns 404 for /llms.txt and for every candidate OpenAPI path, so an agent can only be pointed at a marketing-level overview, not agent-readable API docs. Missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented docs on the developer portal (tryjeeves.redocly.app), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and API-level detail in the existing llms.txt.
